about_the_game:
EMBRACE THE DRAGON: Eastern Elegance for Your Studio


Bring the timeless art and serene majesty of the Far East to Tattuga Bay with the Chinatown Dragon Studio Style Pack. This pack is your ticket to a lavish studio rich in the cultures of Japan and China, perfect for the artist who sees tattooing as a spiritual, not just a physical, craft.

Infuse your parlor with tranquility and power, featuring meticulously crafted furniture, luxurious silk lanterns, and stunning Asian-inspired fashion. Welcome your customers to a world of exquisite detail, where they can wait their turn while relaxing on a Ming-style Bench and admiring the intricacy of your new Dragon Rug.

More importantly, expand your portfolio with 8 incredible new stencils—including three Rare and two Legendary designs—to truly cement your reputation as a master of iconic, breathtaking ink.

New Content Includes:
  • Masterful Ink: 8 new tattoo stencils, including three Rare and two Legendary designs.
  • Exotic Attire: 2 new outfits for each body type, 4 new hairstyles, new glasses, necklaces, and earrings.
  • Lavish Decor: Furnish your studio with the Pagoda-Style Coffee Table, Floor Cushion, Painted Silk Divider, and the elegant Bamboo Bracket Lantern.
  • East Asian Accessories: Dragon Rug, Bamboo Mat, Aquarium, and a fake Ming Vase.
  • Striking Signs: Attract attention with a magnificent Dragon Shop Sign, a majestic Lion Statue, and a Lucky Cat.
  • And more! 40 new furniture objects in total: tables, seats, shelves, lamps, and wall/floor coverings to achieve the perfect East Asian studio vibe.
